title: Exercises
textbookText: Exercises A. Multiple choice questions 1. At constant temperature, what happens to the volume of a gas if the pressure is doubled?

a. It becomes half. b. It doubles. c. It remains the same. d. It quadruples 2. When collecting gases over water, the partial pressure of the collected gas is equal to: a. the atmospheric pressure. b. the vapor pressure of water. c. the sum of the atmospheric pressure and the vapor pressure of water. d. the difference between the atmospheric pressure and the vapor pressure of water. 3. Which of the given figures shows least intermolecular force of attraction and most intermolecular distance among the particles?
a. A b. B c. C d. Both A and C

4. What is the pressure (in atmospheres) exerted by a mixture of 12.0 g of N2 and 12.0 g of O2 in a 2.5 L container at 25°C? Assuming ideal behaviour, which of the following gases will have the greatest volume at STP? a. 1 mol of He. b. 14 g of N 2. c. 5.0 3 10 23 molecules of Cl 2 d. 0.2 mol of CO2 gas
5. Which of the given graph shows the Boyle’s law?
a. X b. Y c. Z d. All are related to Boyle’s
law 6. Which gas law is expressed in the figure given?
a. Boyle’s law b. Charle’s law c. Dalton’s law d. Grahm’s law
7. Which of the following gas has the highest rate of diffusion? a. He b. O3 c. O2 d. N2
8. How much does the volume of the gas increase if we increase the temperature by 1 Degree? a. 273 Ls b. 1 by 273rd of the original volume c. 1 L d. Hundred L

9. Hydrogen sulphide (H2S) has a very strong rotten egg odour. Methyl salicylate(C8H8O3) has a strong "minty" odour, and benzaldehyde(C7H6O) has a pleasant almond odour. If the vapours for these three substances were released at the same time from across a room, which odour would you smell first? a. rotten egg odour b. minty" odour, c. pleasant almond odour d. all odour at the same time

10. A mixture of carbon dioxide and an unknown gas was allowed to effuse from a container. The carbon dioxide took 1.25 times as long to escape as the unknown gas. Which one could be the unknown gas? a. Cl2 b. CO c. HCl d. H2

11. What is the partial pressure (in mmHg) of neon in a 4.00 L vessel that contains 0.838 mol of methane, 0.184 mol of ethane, and 0.755 mol of neon at a total pressure of 928 mm Hg? a. 234 mm b.394 mm c.400 mm d.294 mm

12. A real gas will behave most like an ideal gas under conditions of a. high temperature and high pressure b. high temperature and low pressure c. low temperature and high pressure d. low temperature and low pressure
13. The volume of an ideal gas is zero at a. –45°F b. -273 K c. -363 K d. –273°C
